exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 1-MODUL MUQOVASINING ChAP
BETI.

  Modul muqovasi IKKI BETLIK YOYMA:
     chap bet (bu) — 1 va 2-unitlar
     o'ng bet — 3 va 4-unitlar va
        modul rejasi

  ⚠ Bet raqami bosilmagan.


MODUL NOMI:

  'People & Homes'
     = Odamlar va uylar

  ⚠ '&' belgisi = 'and'. U 'ampersand'
  deb ataladi.

  ⚠ Sarlavhalarda joy tejash uchun
  ishlatiladi; oddiy matnda 'and' yozish
  kerak.


⚠ 'READ, LISTEN, TALK AND WRITE ABOUT...'

  = O'qing, tinglang, gapiring va yozing...

  ⚠ To'rt fe'l — TO'RT KO'NIKMA:
     read   — o'qish
     listen — tinglash
     talk   — gapirish
     write  — yozish

  ⚠ 5-betdagi kirish matnida bu ikki
  guruhga bo'lingan edi:
     RECEPTIVE (qabul qiluvchi):
        read, listen
     PRODUCTIVE (faol):
        talk, write

  ⚠ Hamma BUYRUQ GAPIDA.


UNIT 1 — 'Hi!'

  Mavzular:
     • people; countries; nationalities;
       landmarks
     • jobs

  SURATLAR:
     1) SIDNEY OPERA TEATRI (Avstraliya)
        Oq yelkansimon tomlari bilan
        mashhur bino.
        ⚠ 'a landmark' = diqqatga sazovor
        joy.

     2) ShOTLAND VOLINKAChISI
        Qora beret, katakli KILT (erkaklar
        yubkasi), oq paypoq, volinka.
        ⚠ 'bagpipes' = volinka (har doim
        KO'PLIKDA).
        ⚠ 'a kilt' = shotland erkaklar
        kiyimi.
        ⚠ 'tartan' = shotland katak
        naqshi; har urug'ning o'z naqshi
        bor.

  ⚠ Ikki surat ikki MAMLAKATNI
  bildiradi — unit millatlar haqida.


UNIT 2 — 'A Friend in Need!'

  Mavzular:
     • people's facial features
     • colours
     • abilities

  SURATLAR:
     1) Basseyn chetida bir-biriga QO'L
        ChO'ZAYOTGAN o'smirlar — kimdir
        yordam bermoqda.
        ⚠ Bu aynan sarlavhaning ma'nosi:
        do'st yordam beradi!

     2) Qizil xitoy libosidagi kulib
        turgan qiz.

  ⚠ 'facial features' = yuz tuzilishi
  (ko'z, burun, og'iz, soch).
     'a face' → 'facial' (sifat)


⚠ KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIK:

  Bu yerda: 'A Friend in Need!'
     — UNDOV belgisi bilan
  Mundarijada: 'A Friend in Need...'
     — UCh NUQTA bilan

  ⚠ Ma'no bir xil, faqat tinish belgisi
  boshqa.

  ⚠ To'liq maqol: 'A friend in NEED is
  a friend INDEED.'


⚠ MODUL MUQOVASI NIMA UChUN KERAK:

  Modul boshlanishidan oldin o'quvchi
  KUTILAYOTGAN mavzular bilan tanishadi.

  ⚠ Bu — 'Pre-reading Activity' bilan
  bir xil g'oya, faqat kattaroq
  miqyosda: rasm va ro'yxatga qarab
  nima o'rganishni oldindan bilish.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a module      = modul
  an ampersand  = '&' belgisi
  a landmark    = diqqatga sazovor joy
  bagpipes      = volinka
  a kilt        = kilt (shotland yubkasi)
  tartan        = shotland katak naqshi
  facial features = yuz tuzilishi
  a face        = yuz
  facial        = yuzga oid
  an ability    = qobiliyat
  a nationality = millat
  an opera house = opera teatri

exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — 1-MODUL MUQOVASINING O'NG
BETI.

  Bu yerda modulning MAQSADLARI va
  3-4-unitlar berilgan.


⚠ 'MODULE 1 — UNITS 1 - 4'

  ⚠ Modul tarkibi yana bir bor
  tasdiqlanadi: 1-modulda TO'RT unit.

  ⚠ Eslatma: 4-modulda esa UChTA unit
  (13-15). Shuning uchun orqa muqovadagi
  'four units each' da'vosi noto'g'ri.


'LEARN HOW TO ...' — TO'RT MAQSAD:

  • introduce people
     = odamlarni tanishtirish
  • greet; say goodbye
     = salomlashish; xayrlashish
  • ask for and give adresses &
    phone numbers
     = manzil va telefon raqamini so'rash
       va aytish
  • identify people
     = odamlarni tanib olish

  ⚠ Bu to'rttasi 3-betdagi mundarijaning
  'COMMUNICATION' ustunidagi 1-4-unit
  bandlariga AYNAN mos keladi.


⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo):

  Kitobda: 'ask for and give ADRESSES'

  ⚠ To'g'risi: ADDRESSES — IKKITA 'd'.

  ⚠ Kesib kattalashtirib tekshirdim —
  kitobda aniq bitta 'd' bosilgan.

  ⚠ 'an address' = manzil
     ad-dress: 'ad-' + 'dress'

  ⚠ Photo File 14-unit varag'idagi Britaniya xat manzilida
  bu so'z to'g'ri ishlatilgan edi.


'PRACTISE ...' — SAKKIZ GRAMMATIKA
MAVZUSI:

  • a-an/plurals
  • to be/have (got)/can
  • this/these - that/those
  • there is/there are
  • possessive adjectives/pronouns
  • possessive case
  • prepositions of place
  • present simple


⚠⚠ FOYDALI TASDIQ — 'PRACTISE':

  Sarlavhada 'PRACTISE ...' — 's' bilan.

  ⚠ Bu TO'G'RI, chunki bu yerda FE'L
  (buyruq gapi: 'mashq qiling').

  ⚠ 166-betdagi qoida:
     'practiCe' — OT ('c' bilan)
     'practiSe' — FE'L ('s' bilan)

  ⚠ Bu — o'sha qoidaning AMALIY misoli.


UNIT 3 — 'Home, Sweet Home!'

  Mavzular:
     • houses around the world & their
       special features
     • furniture & appliances

  SURATLAR:
     1) ShVEYSAR USLUBIDAGI YOG'OCh UY
        Keng qiya tom, balkonda gullar.
        ⚠ 'a chalet' [SHA-ley] deb ataladi
        (fransuzcha so'z, 't' JIM).

     2) TOR QORA-QIZIL QAYIQ
        Suv ustida turgan uzun qayiq.
        ⚠ 'a narrowboat' = Britaniya kanal
        qayig'i. Odamlar unda YAShAYDI!

  ⚠ Ikki surat 'houses around the world'
  mavzusini ochadi: uy har xil bo'lishi
  mumkin — hatto qayiq ham.

  ⚠ Photo File 3-unit varag'i va Photo File 3-unit yozish varag'i Photo File
  varaqlari shu unitga tegishli.


UNIT 4 — 'Like Father, Like Son!'

  Mavzular:
     • families & relationships
     • likes & dislikes

  SURATLAR:
     1) Koptok o'ynayotgan ikki qizcha
     2) UCh AVLOD oilaviy surati:
        buvi-bobo, ota-ona va bolalar

  ⚠ 'likes & dislikes' = yoqadigan va
  yoqmaydigan narsalar.
     'to like' → 'likes' (OT!)
     'to dislike' → 'dislikes'

  ⚠ 'dis-' = inkor qo'shimchasi.


⚠ KIChIK NOMUVOFIQLIKLAR:

  Bu yerda:  'Home, Sweet Home!'
     (VERGUL bilan)
  Mundarijada: 'Home Sweet Home'
     (vergulsiz)

  Bu yerda:  'Like Father, Like Son!'
     (ikkinchi 'Like' BOSh harf)
  Mundarijada: 'Like Father, like Son'
     (kichik 'like')

  ⚠ Ma'no o'zgarmaydi — faqat yozilish
  farqi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an address    = manzil
  to greet      = salomlashmoq
  to identify   = tanib olmoq
  to practise   = mashq qilmoq (FE'L)
  practice      = mashq (OT)
  a chalet      = shveysar uslubidagi uy
  a narrowboat  = kanal qayig'i
  furniture     = mebel
  an appliance  = maishiy texnika
  a relationship = munosabat, qarindoshlik
  likes and dislikes = yoqadigan va
                  yoqmaydigan narsalar
  a generation  = avlod
  possessive    = egalik bildiruvchi
